title: Malicious code in @yshtxxproject/baileys (npm)
description: The npm package '@yshtxxproject/baileys' is a trojanized fork of the legitimate Baileys WhatsApp library. It contains malicious code that, upon connection, automatically subscribes the victim to attacker-controlled WhatsApp newsletter channels using hardcoded newsletter JIDs. This behavior is not present in the legitimate Baileys library. All published versions of this malicious package are affected. Systems with this package installed should be considered fully compromised.
